author: Jeff Geerling
description:
There was far too much to cram into such a short amount of time. But I made the best of it.

Here are projects I referenced, products I used, and other creators I mentioned who you should most definitely be subscribed to.

  - My Tufty 2350 GPS Time Badge project: https://github.com/geerlingguy/tufty-gps-time
  - Pimoroni Tufty 2350: https://shop.pimoroni.com/products/tufty-2350?variant=55811986194811
  - Adafruit MiniGPS STEMMA module: https://www.adafruit.com/product/4415
  - Sean Hodgins' PPS Watch video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AHSqyuOPpf0
  - Sean Hodgins' PPS Watch project: https://github.com/idlehandsdev/pps-watch
  - Robins Tools - Pixel Pump 2: https://www.crowdsupply.com/robins-tools/pixel-pump-2
  - Aaed Musa's channel (he printed my badge clip!): https://www.youtube.com/@aaedmusa
  - The Overengineering Department's Nixie Tube Clock: https://overengineering.department.wtf
  - PianoPi: https://github.com/JBL99/PianoPi
  - CuriousMarc's channel: https://www.youtube.c
title: I can prove I had the best time at Open Sauce
